resolution_caveats.collResSubset: `collRes` is a SUBSET of `resolved` — a resolved edge whose target has MORE THAN ONE declaration in the project, so production's own-file tie-break chose the row. resolution_caveats.mixesInRelabel: ★ `mixes_in` IS A 1:1 RELABEL OF THE USE-DIRECTIVE `uses` ROWS, NOT A NEW EMISSION (2026-10-24, rung R3, no grammar change). `use Mod` was published as `uses{isMixin:true}`; it is `mixes_in` now, with the same source (the using module), target, line and confidence, and `metadata.isMixin` is kept. Per-file reconciliation measured over all 855 files: exactly 1 file disagrees (kernel.ex sites=1 rows=0); the other 854 agree one-for-one.
